run_clip_training: run the CLIP model training loop with distributed data parallel and mixed precision support
create_model_and_transforms: create a CLIP model and its train/val preprocessing transforms from a config name
resume_checkpoint_training: resume CLIP training from a saved checkpoint file at a specific step
set_random_seed: set the random seed for torch, numpy, and python random across distributed ranks
configure_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer with weight decay exclusion for bias, norm, and logit_scale params
